item.name: Tray_Grids_and_Mats
item.description: Food-contact grids and mats that hold servings above sealed ice bags.
item.readyBeforeUse: Every grid and mat is clean, sanitized, air-dry, and intact.
item.readyForNextPerson: During service, every grid and mat is clean and protected from contamination. After service, each is washed, rinsed, sanitized, air-dry, and stored.
item.ifNotReady: Do not use a damaged or dirty grid or mat. Tell the Food Lead.
